Recovery policy transcription (era-scoped @pinned sha, DUPLICATE of prior watchdog records but re-confirmed executing): three-tier rerun gate — (1) cancelled + runner-infrastructure shutdown signature regex → rerun --failed with full-run fallback; (2) literal SPIDER_TRANSIENT_OX_EXHAUSTED marker → rerun --failed only, no blind full replay; (3) OpenCode/Ox mention CONJUNCTIVE with explicit transient-network regex (ECONNRESET/EAI_AGAIN/ETIMEDOUT/429/5xx/rate-limit family) → rerun --failed only. Refuses blind retry when logs unreadable; never interrupts active runs; explicit 'will not resurrect it' branch for failures without defensible infrastructure evidence.
